dog.description_text:
This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Gigi has been observed to be highly fearful while in care. Noted to have a tense body and tucked tail. When returning to kennel, Gigi is observed to balk on leash. This behavior is able to be redirected with coaxing and mild leash pressure. Due to the detailed behavior, we recommend an experienced adult only home.

A Volunteer Wrote: If eyes are the soul of a dog, all you need to do is look into precious Gigi's to know the size of her extraordinary heart and spirit. She's the gentlest, kindest dog, and I thought about her long after our time together, the majority of which she spent in my lap seeking assurance and affection. I cannot whisk her away to my home, but I'm sure hoping you can-she would make the most extraordinary addition to a life, waking up and going to sleep with that sweetness by your side!
dog.name: Gigi
